title: Advertising and playing around the lake
summary: He advertised more than other bands, played lake pavilions, camps and private homes.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Open, huh? Always open. Did you do much playing in the streets?
Advertising more than a band I've ever been in all names.

It pays to advertise. When did you advertise? Oh, it depends on time. I'd be busy on Sundays. I'd plan out at the lake. You know, picnics. You know, and have a dance Monday night. I'd have a dance in the week. In the week? Kennedy. Is that so? Yeah, I see where I could do it. You see? Just take it late in the afternoon, you know. Where did you play? Catch the people. Huh?
At the lake, where did you play?
Oh, in the camps, you mean? Camp, yeah. Call them pavilion, too. Some camps.
You played a lot of private homes out there, too.
Did you play at Tranchinas? Mm-hmm. Did you play in Spanish 4th?
I played in every corner. They liked music.
